segments.t: Cinco minutos y tres decididos giros después, Arthur dobla una esquina de ladrillo soleada convencido de llegar a la plaza del reloj, y se detiene justo debajo de la ventana abierta de la cocina del café del Patio de los Tilos, donde Tessa espolvorea canela sobre unos rollos tibios. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Aha! Behold this quiet historic wall — we must be right behind the clock square!
Good morning again, boss! Did you forget your wallet, or did you miss me?
Tessa?! Why are you standing inside a window behind the municipal clock tower?!
Because three left turns make a circle, Arthur, and this is our own kitchen window!
Wait — tell me you took your famous back-alley shortcut without your glasses again!
Someone clearly moved that green garden fence since last spring!
Look on the bright side: nobody gets hungry on a circular expedition!
Here, take three warm cinnamon rolls in a paper bag before you try again.
Thank you, Tessa, and please do not mention a single word of this to Graham.
My lips are sealed, provided you follow Caleb and the brass compass from here!
Deal! Hand over command of the map cards, Arthur, before twelve noon strikes!
Very well, walk straight up Linden Street — I was merely testing your sense of direction!
Repasemos ahora el cómico desenlace de este «atajo» línea por línea.
Aha! Behold this quiet historic wall — we must be right behind the clock square!
'¡Ajá! ¡Contemplen este tranquilo muro histórico: debemos de estar justo detrás de la plaza del reloj!'
Good morning again, boss! Did you forget your wallet, or did you miss me?
'¡Buenos días de nuevo, jefe! ¿Se olvidó la cartera o ya me echaba de menos?'
Tessa?! Why are you standing inside a window behind the municipal clock tower?!
'¡¿Tessa?! ¡¿Por qué estás de pie en una ventana detrás de la torre del reloj municipal?!'
Because three left turns make a circle, Arthur, and this is our own kitchen window!
'¡Porque tres giros a la izquierda forman un círculo, Arthur, y esta es la ventana de nuestra propia cocina!'
Wait — tell me you took your famous back-alley shortcut without your glasses again!
'¡Espera: dime que volviste a tomar tu famoso atajo por los callejones sin las gafas!'
Someone clearly moved that green garden fence since last spring!
'¡Alguien claramente movió esa valla verde del jardín desde la primavera pasada!'
Look on the bright side: nobody gets hungry on a circular expedition!
'¡Miremos el lado bueno: nadie pasa hambre en una expedición circular!'
Here, take three warm cinnamon rolls in a paper bag before you try again.
'Tomen, llévense tres rollos de canela calientes en una bolsa de papel antes de intentarlo otra vez.'
Thank you, Tessa, and please do not mention a single word of this to Graham.
'Gracias, Tessa, y por favor no le menciones ni una sola palabra de esto a Graham.'
My lips are sealed, provided you follow Caleb and the brass compass from here!
'¡Mis labios están sellados, siempre y cuando sigan a Caleb y la brújula de latón desde aquí!'
Deal! Hand over command of the map cards, Arthur, before twelve noon strikes!
'¡Trato hecho! ¡Entregue el mando de las tarjetas del mapa, Arthur, antes de que den las doce del mediodía!'
Very well, walk straight up Linden Street — I was merely testing your sense of direction!
'¡Muy bien, caminen derecho por la calle Linden: solo estaba poniendo a prueba su sentido de la orientación!'
Escuchemos toda la conversación una vez más.

Good morning again, boss! Did you forget your wallet, or did you miss me?
Tessa?! Why are you standing inside a window behind the municipal clock tower?!
Because three left turns make a circle, Arthur, and this is our own kitchen window!
Wait — tell me you took your famous back-alley shortcut without your glasses again!
Someone clearly moved that green garden fence since last spring!
Look on the bright side: nobody gets hungry on a circular expedition!
Here, take three warm cinnamon rolls in a paper bag before you try again.
Thank you, Tessa, and please do not mention a single word of this to Graham.
My lips are sealed, provided you follow Caleb and the brass compass from here!
Deal! Hand over command of the map cards, Arthur, before twelve noon strikes!
Very well, walk straight up Linden Street — I was merely testing your sense of direction!
Con tres rollos de canela recién horneados y una buena dosis de humildad, nuestros amigos vuelven a salir, esta vez siguiendo la brújula de latón derecho por la calle Linden. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
